page.overview:
Who is Brodie?

Brodie is an old, Reman Halfling of about one hundred winters in age. He is a veteran seaman and an excellent cook.

Brodie doesn't live alone as he raised a Human foundling named Tomas Fenman in his home. Their cabin is located on a wide ledge of rock just twenty feet above high tide, beneath chalk cliffs that form a shadowy white wall around the Bay of Remas. The cabin had been built before Tomas was born, using planks salvaged from a shipwreck. They had both shared this tiny refuge for as long as Tomas could remember.

Like all Halflings, Brodie is a tubby figure less than four feet tall, with a round, friendly face and a touselled head of hair bleached white by the sun. His usual clothes are a faded blue sailor's jacket, leather breeches, and boots that look one size too large. A red silk handkerchief is always stuffed into his breast pocket, a rusty sword is kept in a sheath at his hip, and an ornamental flint knife is hung on a thong around his neck.

Brodie was the ship's cook during Richard Crowell's expedition to Norsca. After the death of that Tilean hero, Brodie took his son Tomas Fenman as his own and vowed to protect him. He never told little Tomas who his real parents were, until the day his father came back for him, having become a Chaos-corrupted Champion of Slaanesh.
